visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a navy blue zip-up hoodie over a black t-shirt and light blue jeans stands on a cruise ship balcony. He looks directly at the camera with an expressive face and points his finger upward while speaking. The background features a harbor with grey water, a breakwater, and a pier where a long line of small figures is visible under a grey sky. (2) The scene shifts to a high-angle overhead shot of a wet asphalt ground. Three individuals are seen running at full speed towards the right side of the frame near a parked white light truck. (3) A wide high-angle shot reveals a massive, dense crowd of people gathered outside a large building with tall windows. Many people are holding colorful umbrellas, indicating a rainy environment. (4) The camera cuts to a night scene on a balcony where a young woman with blonde hair, wearing a black top and a green scarf, looks out towards a lit terminal building with an amazed expression. (5) A nighttime aerial-style panning shot shows a long queue of people extending from a terminal building labeled 'SASEBO PORT' across an open area, illuminated by warm artificial streetlights and building lights.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a cautionary travel tip for cruise ship passengers, advising them to board early to avoid the chaotic situations illustrated: people sprinting to catch the ship, massive crowds waiting in the rain at the gangway, and long terminal queues during customs and immigration checks.
